fields.evidence: gui::registration::VMPlayerRegistrationSystem::ProcessLocalPlayers (NoesisGameUI.dll): clears the set when its key count (+0x2C) is non-zero (line ~236), then after VMLocalPlayerDataSingletonComponent::CreateVM(entity) inserts the entity with FUN_1800f88d0 (lines ~459, ~562). HashSet = StaticArray<int32> buckets +0, Array<int32> NextIds +0x10, Array<key> Keys +0x20; live samples: bucket count at +8, cap/size pairs at +0x18/+0x28. Samples always show an empty key array (size 0), consistent with a per-frame 'newly registered' set.
